name: bedrock-meter
description: Token and USD meter for pay-per-token Amazon Bedrock sessions: per-model input/output/cache counts priced at Bedrock rates

regionalPremiumPct.title: Regional premium (%)
regionalPremiumPct.description: Surcharge Bedrock adds over global pricing for regional and geo (us., eu., apac.) inference profiles. Model ids starting with global. are priced without it. Set 0 to turn it off.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Toast once when the session's estimated cost passes this amount. 0 turns it off.

openPane.title: Open pane at start
openPane.description: Open the breakdown pane when a session starts (it waits for a wide enough terminal). /bedrock-cost opens it anytime.
